notes:
Lead source: self-serve signup (trial credits used).

Initial problem reported: 'Replies feel sluggish at peak — customers see 1–2s lag and UI times out sometimes.' Maya says the webchat shows loader >2s occasionally and users abandon.

What we learned on discovery call (2026-03-05):
- Small ecommerce PQ: ~70 employees, 3 devs, 1 product lead.
- Primary workload: customer support chat + category search powered by embeddings. Chat is highest priority.
- Signups via hosted API; currently using default region (auto) and default client timeout (30s socket). No explicit region pinning.
- Observed spiky latency during US evening PST hours. Likely regional routing to eu nodes for some requests.
- Cost-sensitivity: high (startups tight margin). Prefers guidance that reduces per-token cost without harming UX.

AE notes / quick wins suggested by SE (Ravi):
- Region choice: recommend set region param to us-west-2 or us-east-1 depending on majority of users; test with 24h A/B.
- Timeouts: increase client-side request timeout to 60s for long context flows; set UI-level optimistic streaming fallback at 1.2s to avoid hard spinner.
- Prompt length guidance: trim system prompt to essential directives, move rarely-used context to embeddings/knowledge search. Keep chat history window to last ~800 tokens or 6 most recent turns.
- Streaming: enable streaming responses in the UI to surface incremental tokens; perceived latency drops dramatically even if backend time similar.
- Batching for embeddings: batch up to 8 items where possible to reduce unit cost.
- Caching: prefix caching for common canned answers (10–20% hit rate expected).

Security / compliance notes: customer needs SOC2 and SSO (SAML). They want audit logs for API keys and admin actions. No on-prem requirement; public cloud ok.
